sc25.notes: Re-reviewed on its merits after the background moved from theme.bg to theme.field (same dark field on screen). Company outline and label, then three identical lit store fronts entering left to right (start frame 0.5s, all three by 1.5s), in the storyboard's order. On 'stopped' the middle store's windows go dark (3.8s) and the amber 'closing' tag drops onto its awning about 400 ms later (4.2s, mid frame). On 'carries' the outline and the 'company' label pulse once in slate while the outer stores stay lit (14.2-14.4s) and are back to muted grey by 14.9s; the pulse ends before the fade-out (end frame). Both onScreenText lines legible at 1080p, nothing cut off or overlapping. No names, logos, figures, scale or causal arrow beyond what the BLS passages support; both BLS citations on screen throughout.
